name: Pro Edition
subTitle: Grade 1 English willow
blurb: Our top cut. Straight, tight grains, big edges and a middle that sits where most of your drives are struck. Pressed by hand and finished with a light linseed coat.

name: Players
subTitle: Grade 1 English willow
blurb: Match-grade willow with a slightly wider grain. Picks up lighter than it weighs, which suits front-foot players.

name: Club
subTitle: Grade 2 English willow
blurb: Grade 2 willow with a few cosmetic marks and the same press and shaping as our top bats. The weekend-league favourite.

name: Academy
subTitle: Grade 3 English willow
blurb: Honest English willow for players moving up from tennis-ball cricket to the hard ball. Knocking-in recommended.

name: Junior Harrow
subTitle: Grade 2 English willow
blurb: Sized for players between 5'6" and 5'8". Shorter blade and handle, same willow as our Club bat.

name: Kashmir Match
subTitle: Kashmir willow
blurb: Kashmir willow pressed for the leather ball. Heavier and harder than English willow, and very hard-wearing for net sessions.

name: Street
subTitle: Kashmir willow tennis bat
blurb: Light, whippy and built for the tennis ball. A thin handle and scooped back so you can swing hard in gully and box cricket.

name: Tape Ball Special
subTitle: Kashmir willow
blurb: A low middle and a flat face for the skidding tape ball. Light enough to swing through the line all evening.

name: Box Cricket Lite
subTitle: Popular willow
blurb: Our lightest bat, for indoor box cricket and younger players. Popular willow with a full cane handle.

name: Full Cane Tennis
subTitle: Kashmir willow
blurb: Twelve-piece cane handle for a softer feel off the bat. Our heaviest tennis bat, for players who like a bit of weight behind the shot.

name: Batting Gloves
subTitle: Sausage-finger, men's and youth
blurb: Split-finger sausage rolls with a sheep-leather palm. Right- and left-handed.

name: Batting Pads
subTitle: Lightweight, three-strap
blurb: Cane-reinforced bolsters with a moulded knee roll and three straps.

name: Batting Helmet
subTitle: Steel grille
blurb: Adjustable fit with a steel grille and removable sweatband.

name: Wheelie Kit Bag
subTitle: Holds four bats
blurb: Separate bat sleeve for four bats, a shoe pocket and sturdy wheels for the walk to the ground.

name: Club Leather Balls
subTitle: Pack of 6 · 156 g
blurb: Four-piece, hand-stitched alum-tanned leather balls. Five red and one white.

name: Heavy Tennis Balls
subTitle: Pack of 6
blurb: Hard felt tennis balls that hold their bounce for tape-ball and box cricket.

name: Bat Grips
subTitle: Pack of 3
blurb: Ribbed rubber grips in red, white and green. Fits any standard handle.

name: Toe Guard
subTitle: Fits any adult bat
blurb: Rubber toe guard that stops the toe from soaking up moisture and splitting.
